summary: Shoshone County, ID log cabin with crow's nest built 1922 on the St. Joe NF; a later visit found no cabin remains and the state list marks the site abandoned.

facts.status_note: A visit described on Idaho Fire Lookouts found no remains of the cabin; the Forest Fire Lookout Association list marks the site Abandoned

corrections.why: The state list types the site as Crowsnest, and firelookout.com describes a log cabin with a crow's nest rather than a platform

resolved_conflicts.explanation: firelookout.com says destroyed and a visit found no cabin remains, while the Forest Fire Lookout Association list says Abandoned. Recorded as gone; the list's category is abandoned.
The Idaho Fire Lookouts note dates the visit to September 2026, but the post itself is dated September 18, 2025. The story gives no visit year.

notes_for_editor: Thin record: one line on firelookout.com, one visit note on Idaho Fire Lookouts, one list entry each on the state list and the county list. Built year 1922 is agreed by two sources. No fire or staffing history found. The Nugget Hill site on the same list is a different lookout and was not used. The state list status is Abandoned while the brief says gone; the record keeps gone on the strength of the visit note.
